player_prompt.intro:
Yin e Player {player_id} ee **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Cɔk yin wëu ee **[macro  micro]** (kɔɔr arak 0-8):
• *macro*  = kɔɔr mini-board yin wëu ee
• *micro* = kɔɔr yïïn ee mini-board kɔɔr
Yikëë [7 8] ➜ bɛ̈ɛ̈n yin wëu ee mini-board 7, yïïn 8, ku
kɔɔr yin dɔ̈ɔ̈r ee wëu ee mini-board 8 nɛ̈ɛ̈n.

Yin e `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mi̱ ci̱ jiɛn ba yiath piny kɛ duɔ̱ɔ̱p mi̱ cie [macro micro] kɛnɛ nämbäri̱ 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indi̱dhɛciöni̱ bɛ dhil te kam 0 kɛnɛ 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Kä mikrö_bo̱r, ri̱i̱wni̱ kiɛ kɔlciɛri̱ tekɛ raar kä römdiɛn.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Kä thëll cɛ ku thuŋ thi̱ak.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Ɛn gua̱n ŋarä bɛ dhil te rɛy boor in dɔ̱ŋ.

game_action.played: Riäŋ {player_id} cäthië në thök micro {macro_idx}, thök {micro_idx} (thök {row}, kuɛr {col}). Riäŋ {opponent_id} kä ye jam në {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} ee wɔn Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
outcome.draw: Ɛn duel ɛ mi̱ caa kuɛn!
